svg.title: カリブ・オランダの旅の地図
svg.desc: ボネール、サバ、シント・ユースタティウスの実位置を示す広域地図。北部２島とボネールはそれぞれの実在海岸線を拡大した詳細図を備える。
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS high-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 map subunits ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit NLY (Caribbean Netherlands: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Curaçao, Aruba, Venezuela and the Leeward Islands are context only. Insets: same geometry at uniform scale.
